Floor Pulse Break.name: Floor Pulse Break
Floor Pulse Break.description: The user plugs both jacks into an amplifier and drives their heartbeat through a connected floor. People in a room-sized area stumble, and an opponent braced to attack loses that action; the vibration deals light sonic damage. The user must have the gear and a continuous surface, and the pulse also disrupts unprepared allies standing there. Strain: heavy.
